facts.fact: The NPP says the Ghana Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project was launched in 2020 with a EUR155 million China EXIM Bank facility and an approved target of 2,016 sites for underserved communities, and the Ministry plans to upgrade rural sites to at least 4G.
facts.system: Ghana Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project

facts.fact: The NPP says 1,961 rural telephony sites had been constructed by the January 2025 handover, while alleging many are now non-operational.
facts.system: Ghana Rural Telephony and Digital Inclusion Project
